comment: Known-but-unresolved findings. fingerprint must exactly equal VerificationMismatch.fingerprint (printed in every report and alert as fingerprint). expiresAt is optional ISO time; once passed the finding resurfaces. See docs/SECURITY_MONITORING.md (Known Issues).

issues.note: nostr_lock was officially migrated to a new deployment on 2026-01-14 (see the Nostr migration record in the upgrade whitelist, based on cryptape/nostr-binding official migration files); the CCC SDK static script table has not been synced yet and still references the pre-migration dead cell. Remove this entry once the @ckb-ccc/core script table is updated.

The ckb-explorer testnet script table's Anyone-Can-Pay entry points to an early June 2020 deployment (script_out_point 0x4f32b3e3…:0, type hash 0x86a1c698…, ~351 referencing cells), while the ecosystem-standard deployment (ckb-sdk AGGRON4, ckb-ccc script table, gp flow knowledge base, and this baseline) is type hash 0x3419a1c0… (dep group 0xec26b0f8…). Verified on-chain on 2026-11-24: the code cell type hash resolved from the baseline dep group is 0x3419a1c0…, consistent with every source except ckb-explorer; the baseline is correct and this is a stale ckb-explorer script-table entry. Remove this entry if ckb-explorer updates its ACP entry.
